name: Wedding Guest
tagline: Dressed up and dancing at garden, vineyard and ballroom weddings.
description: Look your best at every kind of wedding: garden ceremonies, vineyard receptions, black-tie ballrooms, beach vows, church steps, cocktail hours, South Asian celebrations and sparkler send-offs. Cocktail, formal and festive attire, plus candid dance-floor joy.
